patterns: Year questions dominate: SEZ policy 2000 (EXIM Policy 2000-01), Act passed 2005, in force 2006; APPSC accepts 'both 2000 and 2006' for 'policy announced'.
FIRSTs and places: Kandla = first EPZ (1965), Surat = first private EPZ, Falta = West Bengal.
APPSC trap: SEZs aim primarily at exports, not employment; FTZs promote export industries.
Other PSCs ask Nandigram (Salim group) and state with most SEZs; AP corridor nodes (Orvakal, Kopparthy, Krishnapatnam) are the AP tilt.
App adds detailed numbers (BHAVYA outlay, export values, s.10AA, s.18) and multi-statement items beyond PYQ depth, but they are factually sound.
